The Sickened and Unconscious conditions from filth fever can't end or be reduced until the disease is cured.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:19]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect ([[/gmr 1d4 #hours]]{1d4 hours})

Stage 2 Sickened 1 (1 day)

Stage 4 unconscious (1 day)

Stage 5 dead

A creature entering the aura or starting its turn in the aura must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:19] save or become Sickened 1 (plus Slowed 1 for as long as it's sickened on a critical failure). actions.description: Casting a Peaceful Rest spell on a carrion golem causes it to grow stiff. The golem attempts a @Check[fortitude|dc:19] save. It's unaffected on a critical success, Slowed 1 for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds} on a success, and on a failure is Immobilized and slowed for 1d4 rounds.

name: Carrion Golem
publicNotes: Carrion golems are foul-smelling and fly-swarmed amalgams of putrefied parts stitched together from many different creatures. Unlike most golems, carrion golems only rarely are given a humanoid form, instead appearing more twisted and bestial in frame. As a result, some students of golem crafting claim that the carrion golem isn't a "true golem," but regardless of those claims these foul constructs certainly share other golem-like traits, including their significant immunities. What is true is that most who craft carrion golems don't do so out of true interest in the technique of golem crafting, but for the golem's ability to spread disease. The crafters of carrion golems send their mindless minions to cause immediate destruction and leave wakes of illness and death behind them.
